resources.string: The server lets this device share folders.
The server does not let this device share folders.
The server lets this device open other devices\' folders.
The server does not let this device open other devices\' folders.
Connect to see whether the server allows it.

Taildrive is switched on in the tailnet\'s policy: the device needs the drive:share attribute, and a grant has to let the other devices reach its folders. Until then the folders below are kept, but nobody sees them.
The tailnet\'s policy has to give this device the drive:access attribute. Without it the other devices\' folders do not open here.
Kept, but not shared while the server does not allow it.
The policy editor opens with a ready rule for Taildrive between your own devices. You review it before anything is saved.
This device may not open shares
The tailnet\'s policy has to give this device the drive:access attribute. An admin can allow it in the policy.
This device\'s own Taildrive closed the connection: the tailnet may not have loaded yet, or its policy does not give this device Taildrive. Connect, then try again.
Unavailable — the tailnet\'s policy does not let this device open shares
Unavailable — Taildrive does not answer; connect and try again
